void use(Object? x) {}

abstract class Api {
  Future<String?> first();
  Future<String?> next(String page);
}

// CASE dart_single_update_body_page expect=pass
Future<void> p1(Api api) async {
  var n = 0;
  for (var page = await api.first(); page != null; n++) {
    use(page);
    page = await api.next(page);
  }
}
